artists.name: Neon Echo
artists.description: Neon Echo is a synth-pop duo known for blending retro 80s synthesizers with modern pop hooks. Their music evokes neon-lit cityscapes and midnight drives. They specialize in moody, energetic tracks that bridge pop accessibility with synthwave nostalgia.
artists.signature_sound: Gated reverb drums, analog synth arpeggios, vocal reverb, dark pop melodies

artists.name: LoRoom
artists.description: LoRoom is a lofi hip hop producer collective specializing in dusty, sample-based beats with warm piano loops and nostalgic vinyl crackle. Their tracks are designed for focus, study, and late-night contemplation.
artists.signature_sound: Vinyl crackle, soft piano loops, muffled drums, ambient background noise

artists.name: Voltline
artists.description: Voltline is an alternative rock band with thunderous guitars and anthemic choruses. They channel raw energy and emotional intensity into every track. Their sound is built for adrenaline and catharsis.
artists.signature_sound: Distorted electric guitars, powerful drumming, soaring vocals, driving bass

artists.name: Orbit Bloom
artists.description: Orbit Bloom creates immersive ambient soundscapes inspired by space, nature, and meditative states. Their music dissolves boundaries between sound and silence, ideal for deep focus and relaxation.
artists.signature_sound: Pads, reverb-drenched textures, field recordings, minimal percussion

artists.name: Slow Stereo
artists.description: Slow Stereo is a jazz trio blending classic standards with modern lounge aesthetics. They specialize in warm, intimate performances that feel like a private concert in a dimly lit jazz club.
artists.signature_sound: Brushed drums, upright bass, soft piano, warm saxophone

artists.name: Indigo Parade
artists.description: Indigo Parade crafts melodic, guitar-driven indie pop with introspective lyrics and jangly arrangements. Their music balances melancholy with optimism, creating emotionally resonant anthems.
artists.signature_sound: Jangly guitars, melodic basslines, warm vocals, indie production

artists.name: Solara
artists.description: Solara is an R&B vocalist and producer combining smooth harmonies with modern electronic production. Her music explores love, self-worth, and late-night intimacy with lush sonic textures.
artists.signature_sound: Layered vocals, smooth synth bass, trap-influenced drums, warm pads

artists.name: Block Theory
artists.description: Block Theory is a conscious hip-hop collective known for sharp lyricism, boom-bap beats, and storytelling that captures urban life. They blend old-school authenticity with contemporary flows.
artists.signature_sound: Boom-bap drums, soul samples, punchy bass, clever wordplay

artists.name: Viktor Klas
artists.description: Viktor Klas is a contemporary classical composer writing minimalist, emotionally evocative piano and string pieces. His work bridges modern minimalism with romantic-era emotional depth.
artists.signature_sound: Solo piano, string quartets, minimal arrangements, emotional dynamics

artists.name: Sage & Cedar
artists.description: Sage & Cedar is an Americana duo weaving folk storytelling with country warmth. Their acoustic-driven songs explore rural life, heartbreak, and the beauty of simple moments.
artists.signature_sound: Acoustic guitar, harmonica, close vocal harmonies, warm production

artists.name: Crimson Forge
artists.description: Crimson Forge is a progressive metal band pushing technical boundaries with complex time signatures, blistering solos, and dark cinematic themes. Their music is a sonic assault on the senses.
artists.signature_sound: Down-tuned guitars, double-kick drums, growled vocals, orchestral layers

artists.name: Coral Sound
artists.description: Coral Sound brings island warmth with roots reggae rhythms, positive messages, and sun-soaked melodies. Their music is a sonic vacation promoting peace, love, and unity.
artists.signature_sound: Offbeat guitar skank, walking bass, organ, warm horns

artists.name: Hollow Creek
artists.description: Hollow Creek is a folk singer-songwriter project rooted in Appalachian traditions. Fingerpicked acoustic guitars, storytelling lyrics, and natural imagery create an intimate connection with listeners.
artists.signature_sound: Fingerpicked guitar, harmonica, raw vocals, natural reverb

artists.name: DJ Flux
artists.description: DJ Flux is an electronic dance music producer known for explosive drops, festival-ready anthems, and euphoric energy. Their tracks are built for massive sound systems and peak-hour dance floors.
artists.signature_sound: Massive synth leads, heavy sidechain, build-ups and drops, four-on-the-floor kicks

artists.name: Max Pulse
artists.description: Max Pulse is a high-energy pop producer creating gym-friendly bangers with massive hooks and driving beats. Their music is engineered for maximum motivation and physical exertion.
artists.signature_sound: Heavy kick drums, shouted vocals, synth stabs, high BPM

artists.name: Paper Lanterns
artists.description: Paper Lanterns crafts delicate, rain-soaked lofi beats with Asian-influenced melodies and gentle textures. Their music feels like a warm cup of tea on a rainy afternoon.
artists.signature_sound: Soft piano, rain sounds, gentle beats, Eastern-influenced melodies
